issue: सौत समान शम्भु पहआयी — पहआयी is not a word as written; every witness (the book, Drik Panchang, Shubh Panchang, tring.co.in) prints it so. It reads as पहँ आयी (पहँ, 'to, near'), with the nasal and the space lost in an early copy.
our reading: She (Gaṅgā) came to Śambhu like a co-wife (पहँ आयी).
alternatives: पहँ आयी written as two words; पहुँ आयी.

issue: स्थित रक्षा लय हित सजाता — the half-line has no verb but सजाता 'arranging'; read as स्थिति (continuance), रक्षा, लय, said of the Goddess.
our reading: You order the world's continuance, protection and dissolution.
alternatives: They (the gods of cau1–2) are set to their tasks of continuance, protection and dissolution.

issue: तापर राजति हरि चतुरानन — on the jewelled throne 'shine Hari and Brahmā' (as in the Śrīvidyā throne whose supports are the gods), or the Goddess shines on it, attended by Hari and Brahmā.
our reading: A throne on which Viṣṇu and Brahmā shine.
alternatives: You shine on it, with Viṣṇu and Brahmā beside you.

issue: कूट चंद्रिका सुभग शिर — कूट 'peak, crest': the moon's light on the crown of her head.
our reading: You whose fair head is crowned with moonlight.
alternatives: A crest-jewel shining like the moon.
